verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe 'Browse with Copilot', which performs actions directly in Microsoft Edge (clicking, typing, navigating tabs) with real-time visibility and user takeover, so it can complete tasks on websites. It is documented only for Edge, pauses for supervision on actions like purchases and bookings, and its use for multi-site research is not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of browser-driven research across websites, support beyond Microsoft Edge, independent or hands-on corroboration that the browser agent completes tasks reliably.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites

citations.quote: Browse with Copilot lets Copilot perform actions directly in your Microsoft Edge browser, such as clicking, typing, and navigating tabs.
All actions run locally in your browser, ensuring full visibility and control.
You can see each step in real time and take control at any time.
Copilot will ask for your attention and supervision for certain actions, such as buying an item, booking a reservation, sending an email, or deleting a calendar event.
